abstract: The Economics of Optimizing Humanity's Outlook is a flagship economic publication within the H Heuristics Polycrisis Resilience Series, based on the concept developed by Hunter Hughes, Founder of H Heuristics (https://polycrisisresilience.hheuristics.com/).

keyFindings.title: Optimizing humanity's outlook is a high-return economic investment opportunity: integrated development, prevention, and resilience portfolios deliver a 12.4x 25-year social benefit-cost ratio compared with 1.5x for reactive post-crisis relief.
Synchronized investment lifts the Cumulative Global Net Economic Value Index (2025=100) to 465 by 2100—more than double Business-as-Usual (215) and 3.6x Unmitigated Loss Drift (128).
By 2050, an annual outlay of $2.9T generates $19.6T/yr in combined GDP convergence dividends and averted damages, scaling to $34.5T/yr by 2075 and $33.0T/yr in averted losses alone by 2100.
Even under conservative 4.5% social discounting, 75-year intergenerational returns reach 17.8x (and 25.6x–38.5x under 1.5%–3.0% intergenerational discount rates).
